channel.title: Namibia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Namibia, every source cited.

item.title: Bank of Namibia raises repo rate by 25 basis points
item.description: Annual home loan repayments increase by N$4 000 as prime lending rate hits 10.50%

item.title: Namibia Breweries partners launch N$13 million water security project
item.description: The five-year Swakop Basin Collective Action Project aims to secure 386 million litres of water annually by 2030.

item.title: Namibia seeks stronger business ties with Russia
item.description: President Nandi-Ndaitwah called for joint ventures and technology transfer at the Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow.

item.title: Namibia construction bill faces calls for action
item.description: The Construction Industries Federation of Namibia urges concrete steps as the long-awaited bill nears Cabinet submission.

item.title: Old Mutual raises SEED prize pool to N$650 000
item.description: 15 entrepreneurs will now receive financial support across five categories in the 2026 programme.
